en.title: Netflix's 2026 Lineup: Tyson, Schumacher, and Untold Stories Hit the Streamer
en.summary: Get ready for a knockout year of sports documentaries on Netflix in 2026. From boxing legends to motorsport icons and the return of the acclaimed Untold series, the streamer is doubling down on compelling athletic narratives.
en.body:
Netflix is gearing up for a monumental year in sports documentaries in 2026, promising a packed schedule for fans worldwide. Following a strong start with the return of **Formula 1: Drive to Survive** and new entries like **Rafa** and **Mourinho**, the streamer is set to deliver even more compelling stories. The upcoming slate includes a four-part docuseries chronicling the life and career of legendary boxer **Mike Tyson**, and a deep dive into **Michael Schumacher**'s incredible maiden Formula 1 world championship win in 1994.

Throughout 2026, Netflix will continue to update its library with fresh sports content. The first quarter of the year already saw the release of **Glitter & Gold: Ice Dancing**, **The Queen of Chess**, and **Formula 1: Drive to Survive Season 8**. The second quarter brought a wave of diverse sports narratives, including **Ronaldinho: The One and Only**, **Full Swing Season 4**, **Beyond the Game: Samurai 2026 World Baseball Classic**, and the highly anticipated **Hulk Hogan: Real American** limited series. Fans also got **Rafa Márquez: El Capitán** and several installments of the popular **Untold** franchise, such as **Untold UK: Jamie Vardy** and **Untold UK: Liverpool's Miracle of Istanbul**.

## The Power of 'Untold'

The critically acclaimed **Untold** docuseries is set to return with Volume 2026, featuring six all-new, character-driven stories. This franchise consistently delivers intimate, introspective looks at athletes and moments that defined sports history. Previous seasons have explored figures like **Steve 'Air' McNair** and **Hope Solo**, promising more personal triumphs and surprising revelations. This year's volume is expected to dive deeper into the extraordinary, offering a wider cultural context for each narrative. The official logline teases "six all-new stories, diving deeper into the extraordinary and the wide (and wild) moments that shaped sports."

## What's Next for Sports Fans

As the year progresses, Netflix has more high-profile releases planned. The latter half of 2026 will feature **Quarterback Season 3** and **WWE Unreal Season 3**, ensuring that fans of team sports and professional wrestling have plenty to binge. The focus on both established legends and untold stories underscores Netflix's strategy to cater to a global audience passionate about the drama, dedication, and sheer spectacle of athletic competition. With such a diverse range of subjects, from boxing and F1 to ice dancing and baseball, Netflix is solidifying its position as a go-to destination for sports documentary enthusiasts.
